mainEntity.name: What are the typical costs associated with building a foundation-based tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a foundation-based tiny home varies significantly based on size, materials, finishes, and the complexity of the design. Generally, costs can range from $150 to $400 per square foot, not including land. Factors like site preparation, utility connections (water, sewer, electricity), foundation type, and permits will also impact the total investment. Custom features and high-end materials will increase the overall price. It's advisable to get a detailed quote for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for foundation-based tiny homes vary widely, typically $150-$400 per square foot, excluding land. Factors include size, materials, site prep, utilities, and permits.
